Title: Public preview: Register Azure subscriptions and Resource Groups with Azure Purview

Body.Content:
Azure Purview now supports multiple source registration for Azure subscriptions or Resource Groups. Set up scans on an entire subscription or resource group with rule sets that can then run at a frequency that meets your business & compliance requirements. 

Learn more.
